items.title: Gulf leaders meet in Qatar in effort to stave off new escalation in U.S and Iran war
items.description: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.

items.title: Kherson braces for return of war as localised Russia-Ukraine truce ends
items.description: Moscow and Kyiv continue strikes elsewhere, but no reported violations in Kherson region during the six-day ceasefire.

items.title: As their doubts about US grow, Gulf Arabs turn to middle powers for security
items.description: The Iran war has exposed Gulf Arab states’ vulnerabilities, including through their reliance on a U.S. whose priorities are diverging from their own.

items.title: Yemen war makes reaching assistance too dangerous for many
items.description: More than 280,000 people have now been displaced by fighting in Yemen and many vulnerable people are unable to access lifesaving relief because it is too dangerous to do so, the UN refugee agency (UNHCR) said on Friday.

items.title: Aid Deliveries and Evacuations in Oleshky Begin After Demining Operation Wraps Up
items.description: Ukrainian and Russian officials said a humanitarian convoy is ready to depart for the besieged town in occupied southern Ukraine.

items.title: Evacuation From Oleshky Completed As Buses Head To Ukraine, Russia
items.description: Moscow and Kyiv say the evacuation of residents from the Russian-occupied Ukrainian city of Oleshky was completed "without incident," as buses filled with civilians left the area for the first time in more than four years under a US-brokered truce that is set to remain in effect until November 1.
